description: Voies cyclables is a dataset listed in Data.StMalo-Agglomération open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Saint-Malo. Dans le cadre de son Plan Vélo, la commune de Saint-Malo augmente chaque année le linéaire de voies cyclables. Coverage: Saint-Malo Agglomération. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are cyclable, vélo, voie, voirie. The portal shows 99 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stmalo-agglomeration-fr-portal.
